ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The figure is circle M, and point M is marked as the center of the circle; vertical segment YZ passes through center M and intersects the circle at upper endpoint Y and lower endpoint Z. Horizontal chord VX intersects the vertical line at point W, and the figure marks WV = 17, WX = 17, and the vertical length from Y to W is 10.5. Then reason: Let the radius of the circle be r, then MY = r. Because YW = 10.5, and M is below W, MW = r - 10.5. Half of the horizontal chord is 17, so in right triangle MWX, MX is radius r, WX = 17, and MW = r - 10.5. By the Pythagorean theorem: r^2 = (r - 10.5)^2 + 17^2. Expanding gives r^2 = r^2 - 21r + 110.25 + 289, so 21r = 399.25, r ≈ 19. Therefore the diameter is approximately 2r = 38.
